audit.whatIsWrong: The page called the lane an even skill matchup at every stage while the content layer and the packet both showed Hwei ahead at 1-3 and first item and Viktor ahead at two items.
audit.why: Hwei's paints outrange Siphon Power (600) and Hextech Ray (525) in the early lane; once Viktor banks Hex Fragments to augment his abilities, the poke war inverts.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 and the first-item window favour Hwei, 4-6 are a skill window, and two-items favours Viktor.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named a nonexistent 'Hex Core' upgrade schedule and 'Death Ray' / 'Chaos Storm'.
audit.why: Viktor's Glorious Evolution grants Hex Fragments on kills; 100 Fragments permanently augments one ability. His E is Hextech Ray and his R is Arcane Storm.
audit.corrected: Spikes rebuilt around Lost Chapter, level 6 (Spiraling Despair vs Arcane Storm), Hwei's first-item burst, and Viktor's augmented late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Arcane Storm is a channel, Siphon Power is a shield plus auto-attack reset, and Gravity Field only stuns after a dwell.
audit.why: Riot's own text flags Arcane Storm as an interruptible channel and Gravity Field as a dwell-stun; Hwei's E torments (Grim Visage, Crushing Maw) are hard CC that cancel a channel outright.
audit.corrected: Hold one E paint for the frame Viktor starts Arcane Storm; bait Siphon Power's 9s shield before detonating the signature; leave the Gravity Field zone before the dwell stun lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Gravity Field is 17/16/15/14/13s and Siphon Power 9/8/7/6/5s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the field.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The title promised one thing and the body explained another.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles, grounded in Viktor's kit.

notes: Cross-layer chart disagreement found: every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Viktor. The full layer was moved to match the content layer, so no paired win[N] edit was possible — win[N] already carries the target value. phases[6].why was rewritten in the same proposal to describe Viktor winning that row. Fabricated names killed: 'Death Ray' -> Hextech Ray, 'Chaos Storm' -> Arcane Storm, 'Power Siphon' -> Siphon Power, 'Hex Core upgrades' -> Hex Fragments/augments. Siphon Power was described as a melee zone; it is 600 range. breakdown.wave was judged templated-adjacent but is Hwei-specific and I had nothing enemy-grounded to replace it with, so it was left alone.
